headline: Russia launches massive multi‑axis strikes as Ukraine offers unconditional ceasefire
subheadline: Russia fired three ballistic missiles into Kyiv, eight cruise missiles Banderol plus two KABs at Odesa, and hit multiple cities with drones and Geran‑5 missiles.
lede: Overnight Russia launched a coordinated barrage of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones across Ukraine, striking Kyiv, Odesa, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv, and Vinnytsia. Ukraine announced a full immediate unconditional ceasefire, but Moscow rejected the offer and continued its offensive, seizing Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in Kharkiv Oblast. In the Middle East, the cargo ship MV Cape Dao was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, leaving two injured and the vessel ablaze, while a powerful explosion rocked Erbil, Iraq, and Iran’s President Pezeshkian warned at the UNGA that the region must choose ‘security together or insecurity together.’

sections.title: Russian multi‑axis strikes and Ukrainian ceasefire offer
sections.body: Russian forces launched three ballistic missiles into Kyiv and eight cruise missiles Banderol plus two KABs at Odesa, while Geran‑5 missiles struck Zhytomyr, Zviahel, and Rivne, and Shahed drones targeted Kharkiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, and the Kirovohrad/Mykolaiv border. Overnight drone attacks hit a gas station in Holosiiv (one injured), warehouses and transport infrastructure in Darnytsia, and the Amstor shopping center in Zaporizhzhia (two wounded). A Russian Mi‑8 violated Polish airspace 300 m deep near Braniewo for 42 seconds, prompting Polish fighter jets to scramble. Ukraine offered a full immediate unconditional ceasefire, but Moscow rejected the proposal and the Russian Ministry of Defense reported the capture of Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in northeastern Kharkiv Oblast.

sections.title: Strait of Hormuz attack and UNGA escalation
sections.body: The cargo ship MV Cape Dao was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in two crew injuries, evacuation, and a fire aboard. A strong explosion was heard in Erbil, Iraq, and an unidentified object exploded over central and southern Iraq, though no casualties or cause have been confirmed. Iran’s President Pezeshkian addressed the UNGA, warning that the region must choose ‘either security together or insecurity together’ and labeling Trump’s remarks as bullying. The IDF activated its 98th Division headquarters in the West Bank, assuming responsibility for the Judea and Etzion brigades amid ongoing terror attacks, and a Hamas financial chief, Mohammed Abu Alwan, was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russia’s refusal to accept Ukraine’s unconditional ceasefire while conducting extensive multi‑axis missile and drone strikes indicates a sustained offensive strategy despite diplomatic overtures. The simultaneous maritime attack on MV Cape Dao, explosions in Erbil and Iraq, and Iran’s defiant UNGA rhetoric suggest a coordinated escalation across multiple fronts in the Middle East, with Iran leveraging both military and diplomatic pressure.
